{
  "summary": "The function processes input bytes into a base64-like encoding, writing to the output buffer. It returns the number of bytes written or VERA_ERR on insufficient output capacity.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_14",
  "algorithm": "base64 encoding with padding",
  "self_confidence": 0.95,
  "claims": [

    {
      "id": "_002",
      "type": "IO",

      "asserted_values": ["len * 4 / 3"],

      "id": "_003",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Writes 4-byte chunks to out using a 64-character lookup table.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.99
    },
    {
      "id": "_004",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the fixed lookup string for encoding.",
      "asserted_values": ["\"AfhmdLEr3GMxg2S/a91UZnTlHOI5KYzevFCwNQ+P4tWV7cpXRbDuykjJsoi6q80B\""],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "_005",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Processes input in 3-byte chunks with special handling for 1-byte and 2-byte remainders.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.99
    },
    {
      "id": "_006",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Writes '=' characters at the end of 4-byte chunks when padding is needed.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.95
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_14(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  const char *lookup = \"AfhmdLEr3GMxg2S/a91UZnTlHOI5KYzevFCwNQ+P4tWV7cpXRbDuykjJsoi6q80B\";\n  size_t o = 0;\n  size_t i = 0;\n\n  if (out_cap < (len + 2) / 3 << 2) {\n    return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;\n  }\n\n  while (i + 3 <= len) {\n    uint32_t chunk = (uint32_t)in[i] << 16 | (uint32_t)in[i+1] << 8 | (uint32_t)in[i+2];\n    out[o] = lookup[(in[i] >> 2) & 0x3F];\n    out[o+1] = lookup[(chunk & 0x3F0000) >> 18];\n    out[o+2] = lookup[((chunk & 0x00FC00) >> 12) | ((chunk & 0x0000C0) >> 6)];\n    out[o+3] = lookup[(chunk & 0x00003F)];\n    o += 4;\n    i += 3;\n  }\n\n  switch (len - i) {\n    case 1:\n      out[o] = lookup[(in[i] >> 2) & 0x3F];\n      out[o+1] = lookup[(in[i] & 0x0F) << 4];\n      out[o+2] = '=';\n      out[o+3] = '=';\n      o += 4;\n      break;\n    case 2:\n      uint32_t pair = (uint32_t)in[i+1] << 8 | (uint32_t)in[i];\n      out[o] = lookup[(in[i] >> 2) & 0x3F];\n      out[o+1] = lookup[(pair & 0x00FC00) >> 12];\n      out[o+2] = lookup[(pair & 0x0000FC) >> 6];\n      out[o+3] = '=';\n      o += 4;\n      break;\n  }\n\n  return o;\n}"
}
